newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico Manzanillo port repair put at 86 mln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Mexico Manzanillo port repair put at 86 mln pesos.

text.p: Mexico's main Pacific port of Manzanillo will spend a total of 86 million pesos to repair damage done during the October 1995 earthquake, the port authority chief said in an interview.
"The cost of repair work totals 86 million pesos," said Carlos Cabanillas Tirado, director of Manzanillo port authority.
Cabanillas added that 30 million pesos were spent in 1995, another 35 million are slated for this year, and an additional 21 million for 1997.
The wharves and the container terminal are already being rebuilt...in a month-and-a-half we start work on rebuilding two warehouses," Cabanillas said.
